amendment_reason: pre-result execution authorization after action/MBB implementation audit

amendment_history.reason: pre-result execution authorization after action/MBB implementation audit

common.binary_label_rule: label[t,h] = 1 iff y[t,h] > 0; exact y[t,h] == 0 maps to class 0
common.model_input_rule: X[t] is exactly the canonical current-row 17-feature vector; the 64-bar context is used only for context/availability eligibility and is never flattened or augmented with lagged or rolling features
common.split_end_rule: for every evaluation split, potential origins, target labels, fills, and four-bar outcomes must remain within that split's right-exclusive end; incomplete cross-boundary tails are excluded from the split score
common.evaluation_split_state_policy: reset each independent diagnostic, primary-validation, and outer-report split to p_start=1.0, commitment countdown=0, and position=1.0; carry policy inventory only across non-overlapping batches within that split; reset separately for model, seed, cost mode, and injected/control arm
common.index_range_contract: all numeric split_range, support_range, fit_prefix_range, prediction_range, fit_raw_range, prediction_raw_range, and body index ranges are zero-based [start,end) right-exclusive; end is excluded and the origin row is never admitted to its fit prefix

learned_fit_contract.train_mask: context_eligible AND target_complete[h] AND target_end <= origin - purge_bars AND row < origin
learned_fit_contract.feature_scaler: sklearn.preprocessing.StandardScaler(with_mean=True, with_std=True) fit separately for each origin and horizon using only train_mask rows; sklearn ddof=0; zero-variance scale is 1; transform-only on evaluation rows
learned_fit_contract.one_class_rule: a LogisticRegression prefix with one observed class is N/A for that origin and horizon, is not repaired or oversampled, and cannot promote

oof.batch_fit_policy: seven chronological OOF-development batches at origins 20000..80000 plus one validation batch at origin 90000; each batch predicts only its next fixed 10000-row interval using one model fit at its origin and its admissible prefix; no later origin label can enter an earlier batch
oof.min_history_rule: count rows satisfying the exact train_mask after context, target, purge, and row<origin filters; this is eligible train-mask row count, not raw prefix length; if count < 16384, that model/horizon/origin is N/A and cannot promote
oof.train_window_rule: expanding eligible prefix with no cap
oof.train_prefix_rule: target_end <= origin - purge_bars and label row < origin
oof.target_mask_rule: reference common.availability.target_window_rule exactly: target_complete[t,h] requires decision row t, target bars t+1..t+h, and every h consecutive 15m edge t->t+1 through t+h-1->t+h; edge t+h->t+h+1 is not required; returns and spot masks apply only to t+1..t+h, funding/mark masks do not invalidate a return label, and target_end=t+h+1 is exclusive
oof.feature_scaling: for Ridge/Logistic, fit StandardScaler(with_mean=True,with_std=True) on train_mask rows for each origin×horizon only (sklearn ddof=0, zero-variance scale=1), then transform-only; baselines are unscaled
oof.early_rows: remain false/NaN; no zero fill, interpolation, or row compaction
oof.same_row_future_perturbation: must not change that row's OOF state; it may change later admissible prefixes
oof.range_semantics: all numeric ranges in this OOF contract are zero-based [start,end) right-exclusive; fit prefixes end before the origin and never include the origin row

primary_inferential_support.range_semantics: fit_prefix_range and prediction_range are zero-based [start,end) right-exclusive; origin 90000 is excluded from the fit prefix
primary_inferential_support.fit_rule: one fit at origin 90000 using admissible prefix [0,90000) filtered by the train mask; score only the next validation interval [90000,100000)

outer_report_operation.range_semantics: fit_prefix_range and prediction_range are zero-based [start,end) right-exclusive; origin 100000 is excluded from the fit prefix
outer_report_operation.fit_rule: after every threshold and manifest field is fixed, fit exactly once at origin 100000 on the admissible prefix [0,100000) with target_end <= origin - purge_bars and label row < origin

availability.origin_context_row_rule: decision origin/context row requires spot_bar_observed, funding_rate_available, mark_close_available, and all 17 model features finite
availability.outcome_label_row_rule: each target bar t+1..t+h requires spot_bar_observed, a finite return, and contiguous 15m adjacency; funding_rate_available and mark_close_available are not required for a return label
availability.context_window_rule: for output-coordinate decision t, require t >= 63 and every current-inclusive index in [t-63,t] (64 rows) to have consecutive 15m timestamps, finite canonical 17 features, and spot_bar_observed=true, funding_rate_available=true, and mark_close_available=true; apply after the raw burn-in slice and pass only X[t] to the model
availability.target_window_rule: for output-coordinate decision t and horizon h, require decision row t plus target rows [t+1,...,t+h] and all h consecutive 15m edges t->t+1 through t+h-1->t+h; returns and spot masks are required only on t+1..t+h, edge t+h->t+h+1 is not required, and target_end=t+h+1 is exclusive
availability.window_rule: one false/missing/non-contiguous required row invalidates the corresponding context or target window; required masks are not interchangeable
availability.gap_policy: retain original timestamps and false masks; never sort, compress, interpolate, or convert missing to observed zero

action_contract.candidate_dedup_rule: canonical candidate_positions clips current_position + each candidate delta to [0.5,1.0], rounds to 12 decimal places, and applies np.unique; action selection still evaluates the canonical delta list
action_contract.argmax_tie_rule: max(value, -abs(delta), -delta): maximize value, then choose the smallest absolute delta, then the more-negative delta
action_contract.execution_rule: decision t -> full fill t+1 -> fixed position returns t+1..t+4
action_contract.reoptimization_rule: no reoptimization inside a four-bar commitment; next decision at t+4 and next fill at t+5
action_contract.partial_fill_policy: unsupported; record N/A and do not repair
action_contract.utility_o2_o3: same four-bar pathwise utility with calibrated joint scenarios; no independent marginal synthesis
action_contract.oracle_reference: same feasible action set and trajectory using realized four-bar return path; report-only upper bound
action_contract.student_or_policy_inventory: previous realized policy position from the same replay, never teacher or hindsight inventory
action_contract.clairvoyant_state_policy: at every scored origin, use the same current inventory p_{t-1} carried by the forecast policy; never source inventory from hindsight, U0 global DP, or a teacher trajectory
action_contract.action_agreement_definition: compare forecast-optimal next position and realized four-bar one-block optimal next position from the same p_{t-1} and feasible action set
action_contract.regret_definition: realized best four-bar utility minus chosen utility from the same p_{t-1}; opportunity denominator is realized clairvoyant utility minus same_state_local_hold utility from that same p_{t-1}
action_contract.benchmark_hold_path: independent benchmark replay reset to p_start=1.0, commitment countdown=0, and position=1.0; delta=0/position=1.0 throughout; use the same score mask and cost-free transition semantics
action_contract.same_state_local_hold_path: for regret/opportunity only, evaluate delta=0 from each candidate policy's own carried p_{t-1}; do not substitute the independent benchmark hold path
action_contract.s3_did_hold_path: S3 timing DID subtracts each injected/control candidate's independent benchmark_hold_path; local same-state hold is reserved for that candidate's regret/opportunity
action_contract.inventory_transition_rule: only the chosen policy action advances that policy's p_{t-1} to the next block; clairvoyant/U0 paths never feed back into policy inventory
action_contract.u0_global_dp_role: report-only upper bound; it cannot define per-row clairvoyant state, action agreement, regret, or policy inventory

action_execution_contract_reference.hash_method: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes with sorted keys and compact separators

cost_mode_contracts.derivation: geometry, masks, timing, and inventory semantics are copied from the canonical cost-on JSON; only spread_bps, slippage_bps, fee_rate, and transition_cost_rate are deterministically replaced with zero for cost-off

off.hash_method: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes with sorted keys and compact separators

on.hash_method: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes with sorted keys and compact separators

known_cache_local_snapshot.role: untrusted cache-local metadata snapshot observed during preregistration review; not an authority and not a committed input
known_cache_local_snapshot.difference_from_frozen: metadata_sha256 and source_provenance_digest differ from the repo-frozen values because the local source-probe ledger revision differs; schema/content digests and row counts match

v4_load_contract.cache_local_metadata_policy: read only when present; echo cache-local file SHA, source-provenance digest, schema digest, content digests, and row counts separately; never pass cache-local metadata as metadata_path or replace the frozen metadata
v4_load_contract.cache_local_frozen_difference_policy: do not hide any local-versus-frozen difference; content/schema/cache-tag/row-count mismatch blocks S3, while a source-provenance revision difference is retained in the artifact for explicit disposition before promotion
v4_load_contract.body_validation_policy: the runner must call load_cache_v4 with all explicit feature, returns, availability, and frozen metadata paths, then verify content digests, schema digest, cache tag, and row counts before any S3 run
v4_load_contract.source_provenance_difference_policy: a known source-provenance-only difference is recorded separately and permits the run only when body content/schema/cache-tag/row-count checks match; promotion requires an explicit disposition field
v4_load_contract.missing_unknown_mismatch_policy: absent or unknown provenance, missing body, or any body content/schema/cache-tag/row-count mismatch blocks S3 before fitting or scoring
v4_load_contract.runtime_authentication_policy: production P1 entrypoint must call load_fixed_manifest first, then delegate the authenticated frozen manifest to the body validator; caller mappings and forged manifest_sha256/results_observed/frozen digests are rejected before body validation
v4_load_contract.runtime_path_override_policy: path_overrides may replace the four explicit body paths only as a complete set; cache_dir/cache_tag-only lookup is forbidden

action_primitive_schema_reference.hash_method: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), allow_nan=false; external schema is authoritative for primitive hashes

gap_scoring_semantics.feature_or_context_gap: decision origin is ineligible for forecast and action-agreement scoring; retain timestamp and false mask; do not synthesize a new action
gap_scoring_semantics.active_commitment_feature_gap: after a valid fill, hold the committed position and include the four-bar PnL if its outcome window is complete; do not reoptimize or impute a feature
gap_scoring_semantics.execution_gap: fill/observation skip follows execution_skip_policy=hold_commitment, is recorded, and is not treated as a new action
gap_scoring_semantics.outcome_gap: any missing/non-finite/non-contiguous spot return in t+1..t+4 excludes the complete block from PnL, utility, regret, agreement, and all benchmarks; funding/mark gaps alone do not
gap_scoring_semantics.pnl_scored_mask: valid_fill_or_active_hold_commitment AND four_bar_outcome_complete; an active feature gap is scored as the committed hold

on.round_trip_rule: charge the same one-way transition rule on each position change

zero_return.continuous_prediction: zero cumulative return for every horizon h
zero_return.action_role: fixed non-learned comparator; h4 action uses the same Q mapper

persistence_last_observed.continuous_prediction: h * return[t] where return[t] is the last observed one-bar log return at decision t
persistence_last_observed.binary_prediction: class-1 probability 1-eps when return[t] > 0, otherwise eps, with eps=1e-6; exact zero is class 0
persistence_last_observed.action_role: fixed non-learned comparator; h4 action uses the same Q mapper

ridge.action_role: sole learned h4 action mapper; no probability-to-return conversion

logistic.action_role: binary proper-score diagnostic only; action utility is N/A

coverage_definitions.potential_origin_rule: within each right-exclusive prediction support, an origin with 64-bar history and a target tail t+1..t+h fully inside that split end; no cross-split tail is potential
coverage_definitions.eligible_fraction: context_complete AND target_complete[h] / potential_origins for each h
coverage_definitions.finite_prediction_fraction: finite model prediction / eligible context-and-target origins for each h
coverage_definitions.scored_action_fraction: scheduled complete canonical four-bar blocks with eligible origin, finite h4 forecast, and complete realized four-bar outcome / all scheduled complete canonical four-bar blocks inside the split
coverage_definitions.split_end_rule: exclude any target, fill, or outcome crossing the split's right-exclusive end; preserve full row grid and masks
coverage_definitions.reporting_scope: echo every required horizon, model, seed, cost mode, and injected/control arm before applying thresholds; undefined or N/A coverage blocks promotion

metrics.reporting_rule: report point estimate, denominator, and interval; undefined metrics are N/A and cannot promote

synthetic.range_semantics: fit_prefix_range and prediction_range are zero-based [start,end) right-exclusive; origin 90000 is excluded from the fit prefix

s3.range_semantics: fit_raw_range and prediction_range_raw are original zero-based [start,end) raw-body indices; validation origin 104528 is excluded from the fit prefix

primary_support_policy.outer_test_role: report_only; never a gate, selection, or tuning support

primary_metric_formulas.forecast_mse_skill: 1 - MSE(model, y_h4) / MSE(zero_return, y_h4), evaluated on the same complete-target rows
primary_metric_formulas.normalized_action_regret: per seed and bootstrap replicate, sum(action_regret_vs_clairvoyant) / sum(clairvoyant_net_utility - same_state_local_hold_net_utility) using the same current inventory p_{t-1} for every action; require a strictly positive aggregate opportunity denominator
primary_metric_formulas.s2_timing_net_utility_delta: mean over scored rows of [Ridge policy net utility - independent benchmark_hold_path net utility] at each SNR level, with the policy's own carried p_{t-1}; benchmark hold is reset p=1 and cost-free
primary_metric_formulas.s3_mse_skill_difference_in_differences: skill(injected Ridge vs injected zero) - skill(control Ridge vs control zero), where skill(A vs B)=1-MSE(A)/MSE(B), on identical timestamps
primary_metric_formulas.s3_timing_net_utility_difference_in_diff: [Ridge-minus-independent-benchmark_hold_path net utility]_injected - [Ridge-minus-independent-benchmark_hold_path net utility]_control using only a common timestamp score mask; injected/control candidate inventories reset and carry independently, and local same-state hold is only for each candidate's regret/opportunity
primary_metric_formulas.benchmark_hold_utility_delta: candidate net utility minus an independent p_start=1, position=1, delta=0, cost-free benchmark hold on the same score mask
primary_metric_formulas.s1_clairvoyant_comparison: for each S1 seed, compare mean realized net utility/value of the same-state clairvoyant and Ridge on the identical scored validation mask; require clairvoyant strictly greater, with no cumulative-path or mask mismatch
primary_metric_formulas.s2_shared_randomness: S2 high, medium, and low use identical base features, return-noise draws, sidecar gap masks, seeds, and row support; only beta changes

gates.multiplicity_method: Holm-Bonferroni over the fixed primary comparison family

block_bootstrap.forecast_primitive_grid: the complete validation-split time-series row grid in original order; N/A/missing rows remain in place and are never compressed
block_bootstrap.action_primitive_grid: all structurally complete scheduled non-overlapping four-bar blocks inside the split, one record per block in original chronological order; split-local scheduled starts are 0,4,... from canonical complete_decision_starts; outcome/forecast gaps remain false-mask N/A records and are never compressed; selected_delta is the canonical chosen delta, selected_position is the clipped/deduplicated chosen position, previous_position is policy state before the block, turnover=abs(selected_position-previous_position), and active_indicator=1 iff turnover>0

action_primitive_schema.schedule_rule: split-local scheduled starts are 0,4,... from canonical complete_decision_starts; global decision index = support_start + local decision index; one record per scheduled non-overlapping four-bar block in original order
action_primitive_schema.gap_policy: retain every scheduled primitive record in original order; mask forecast/outcome gaps false and exclude them from metric denominators without dropping or compressing records

canonical_serialization.index_semantics: primitive_index is the zero-based full-grid row ordinal; decision_index is the output-coordinate t; fill_index=decision_index+1; end_index=decision_index+4 is the inclusive final return bar; scheduled decision indices advance by four
canonical_serialization.field_order: record_fields exactly as listed; no sorting or omission
canonical_serialization.row_order: original chronological primitive_index order; retain every scheduled full-grid row including false-mask gap rows
canonical_serialization.shape: each field is a one-dimensional array of shape (record_count,), encoded in C order
canonical_serialization.value_encoding: little-endian IEEE-754 float64 (=<f8); finite values preserve bits and every NaN uses 0x7ff8000000000000; infinities rejected
canonical_serialization.bool_encoding: strict bool encoded one byte each as 0x00 or 0x01
canonical_serialization.string_encoding: UTF-8 bytes with a little-endian uint64 byte-length prefix per value
canonical_serialization.field_framing: field name and ASCII dtype tag are uint64-length-prefixed; ndim=1 and the one-element shape use little-endian uint64; data byte length is uint64-prefixed before field bytes
canonical_serialization.content_framing: magic UNIDREAM-P1-ACTION-PRIMITIVE-CONTENT\x00 followed by uint64 record_count and fields in record_fields order
canonical_serialization.payload_framing: magic UNIDREAM-P1-ACTION-PRIMITIVE-PAYLOAD\x00 followed by length-prefixed canonical UTF-8 JSON header and length-prefixed canonical content bytes
canonical_serialization.json_encoding: UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), allow_nan=false

hash_scopes.action_primitive_schema_sha256: SHA-256 of the external schema canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes; external digest is pinned outside the payload
hash_scopes.action_primitive_content_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical framed bytes for every record_fields field and every original full-grid row; hash fields excluded
hash_scopes.action_primitive_payload_sha256: SHA-256 of payload magic, canonical JSON header containing record_count/record_fields/schema_sha256/content_sha256, and canonical content bytes; payload hash excluded
hash_scopes.full_grid_gap_policy: false-mask/N/A rows remain physically present and contribute their canonical mask/value bytes; metrics alone exclude them

block_bootstrap.action_bootstrap_replay_policy: resample stored canonical action block record indices and recompute declared means/sums/ratios/DiD; never replay policy state over a resampled or nonchronological sequence
block_bootstrap.action_inventory_boundary_policy: inventory and state are fixed inside each stored block record; bootstrap block boundaries and duplicate sampled records never carry or replay inventory state
block_bootstrap.primitive_unit_for_L: each moving-block length L is measured in the applicable primitive records, not compacted valid rows
block_bootstrap.resampling_unit: contiguous non-circular blocks within each seed/split primitive grid; same sampled indices for candidate and paired baseline
block_bootstrap.non_circular_mbb: require n >= L; for each replicate draw starts=rng.integers(low=0, high=n-L+1, size=ceil(n/L), endpoint=False, dtype=np.int64), materialize indices=starts[:,None]+np.arange(L,dtype=np.int64) in C-order, flatten and truncate to the first n primitive records; no circular wrap and no gap compression
block_bootstrap.mbb_index_materialization: indices = starts[:,None] + np.arange(L,dtype=np.int64); flatten in C order and take the first n indices
block_bootstrap.rng_lifecycle: for each unit/support/seed/L create np.random.default_rng(derived_seed) exactly once, then draw all replicate starts in replicate order b=0..1999; do not reinitialize per replicate, arm, or comparison
block_bootstrap.rng_seed_ordinal: synthetic uses the fixed seed-list ordinal 0..9; S3 uses ordinal 0
block_bootstrap.index_reuse: within a fixed unit/support/seed/L, reuse identical sampled primitive indices for every arm and comparison; seed derivation is independent of loop order
block_bootstrap.paired_common_mask: for every paired arm/comparison, use the fixed intersection eligible mask on the full primitive grid; non-common or N/A records stay present with false mask and are excluded only by metric masking
block_bootstrap.paired_delta_formula: d_i = candidate_i - baseline_i on the same primitive record; each replicate resamples the full primitive arrays and recomputes the declared metric before forming its paired contrast

replicate_metric_recomputation.mse_delta: mean(SE_candidate)-mean(SE_baseline) on the retained full grid mask
replicate_metric_recomputation.skill: 1-sum(SE_model)/sum(SE_zero) on the retained full grid mask
replicate_metric_recomputation.logloss: mean per-record log loss and paired contrast on the retained full grid mask
replicate_metric_recomputation.agreement: mean agreement indicator and paired contrast on the retained full grid mask
replicate_metric_recomputation.policy_utility_delta: mean(candidate_net_utility-independent_benchmark_hold_net_utility) using the same primitive action records
replicate_metric_recomputation.s2_contrast: recompute each level's metric, then form the registry-directed adjacent level contrast
replicate_metric_recomputation.normalized_regret: recompute sum(regret)/sum(opportunity) separately at each level, require positive aggregate opportunity, then form the registry-directed contrast
replicate_metric_recomputation.s3_skill_did: recompute skill(injected Ridge vs injected zero)-skill(control Ridge vs control zero)
replicate_metric_recomputation.s3_utility_did: recompute mean(candidate-independent_benchmark_hold) in injected minus the same mean in control

block_bootstrap.invalid_replicate_policy: keep the fixed full-grid common eligible mask; sampled N/A records remain mask-out and are not dropped or compacted; N/A the entire comparison only when n<L, valid primitive count is zero, an arm's required metric is unavailable, or a denominator is zero/nonpositive
block_bootstrap.denominator_policy: if any required comparison denominator is zero or nonpositive in a replicate or required arm, mark the entire comparison N/A/blocked; never repair, omit, or resample away the denominator failure
block_bootstrap.seed_aggregation: for synthetic comparisons, independently resample blocks within each seed and compute that seed's mean; aggregate the ten seed means with equal 1/10 weight, never row-count weighting; S3 is one timestamp stratum
block_bootstrap.interval_formula: two-sided percentile interval [quantile_0.025, quantile_0.975] for each fixed block length over exactly 2000 fixed-seed replicates; intervals are diagnostic only
block_bootstrap.sensitivity_conservative_rule: for each comparison, raw_p = max(p_block_length_8, p_block_length_16, p_block_length_32); use this intersection-union conservative p as the sole input to Holm; each block-length interval remains diagnostic
block_bootstrap.utility_gate: non-S0 utility gates use the Holm-adjusted one-sided p from raw_p; no gate is formed by requiring an unadjusted lower bound at all block lengths

holm.p_value_formula: for favorable positive contrast q_i, p_L=(1 + count_b(T_b,L <= 0))/(B+1); for favorable negative contrast q_i, p_L=(1 + count_b(T_b,L >= 0))/(B+1), with B=2000 for each L in {8,16,32}, then raw_p=max(p_8,p_16,p_32)
holm.direction_transform: transform each contrast so favorable evidence is positive before applying the positive-tail formula; high_le_medium uses medium_minus_high, medium_le_low uses low_minus_medium, and null non_positive uses the positive-edge tail
holm.ordering: sort raw p-values ascending; break exact ties by comparison_id lexicographic order
holm.step_down: with sorted rank r in 1..m, reject rank r iff every rank j<=r satisfies p_(j) <= familywise_alpha/(m-j+1); stop at the first failure; adjusted_p_(r)=min(1,max_{j<=r}((m-j+1)*p_(j)))
holm.gate_rule: a positive/negative primary comparison passes only when its direction is favorable and its Holm step-down adjusted p <= 0.05; S0 non_positive is a safety gate requiring a Holm-rank-adjusted positive-direction lower bound <= 0 at every L in {8,16,32}, and positive-edge Holm rejection=false
holm.s0_adjusted_lower_bound: after conservative raw_p ordering assigns rank r, alpha_r=familywise_alpha/(family_size-r+1); for each L, lower_bound_L is quantile_alpha_r(T_b,L) for the positive-edge contrast, and S0 passes only when every lower_bound_L <= 0
holm.ci_role: two-sided percentile intervals at L in {8,16,32} are fixed reporting diagnostics; only conservative raw_p=max(p_8,p_16,p_32) enters Holm for non-S0 contrasts, with no post-output choice of tail or block length

wilson.formula: phat=x/n; center=(phat+z^2/(2n))/(1+z^2/n); half=z*sqrt(phat*(1-phat)/n+z^2/(4n^2))/(1+z^2/n); interval=[center-half,center+half]; no normal approximation
wilson.action_agreement_gate: S1 Ridge cost-on only: point agreement >= 0.90 on every seed and pooled Wilson lower bound >= 0.90 on synthetic_validation; S2-high is evaluated only by its S2 monotonic registry comparisons
wilson.coverage_gate: all required coverage fractions must meet their fixed scenario threshold

monotonicity.scope: S2 high, medium, low SNR, evaluated on the same seed and synthetic_validation row support [90000,100000)
monotonicity.point_estimate: display the median of the ten per-seed metric values; adjacent point contrasts use the median contrast
monotonicity.point_gate: both adjacent registry-directed median contrasts and their 1e-12 tie-tolerance direction conditions must pass; point direction and Holm-adjusted p are jointly required
monotonicity.aggregation: within each seed compute the metric on its common support, then the bootstrap statistic equal-weights the ten seed metric values at 1/10; point reporting/gating uses their median, never row-count weighting; S3 has one timestamp stratum
monotonicity.decision_formula: for an ordered triple (high,medium,low), pass iff each adjacent inequality holds after adding tie_tolerance to the right-hand side for <= or subtracting it for >=
monotonicity.violation_policy: record violation and fail the monotonicity gate; no post-output tuning or scenario deletion

zero_signal.scope: S0 action-capable Ridge and persistence only, cost-on; zero_return is the hold baseline, Logistic action is N/A, and cost-off is diagnostic-only
zero_signal.promotion_rule: no candidate may pass the positive utility or high-agreement gate; any apparent pass is a preregistration/implementation failure
zero_signal.utility_rule: for each L in {8,16,32}, the Holm-rank-adjusted positive-direction lower percentile for candidate-minus-independent-benchmark_hold_path net utility must be <= 0 and the positive-edge Holm rejection must be false; this is a safety gate, not evidence that the true edge is negative
zero_signal.agreement_rule: pooled Wilson lower bound must remain below 0.90

high_snr_recovery.scope: S1 Ridge cost-on on synthetic_validation, ten seeds; S2-high is handled by the fixed S2 monotonic comparisons
high_snr_recovery.agreement_per_seed_rule: all ten S1 Ridge cost-on validation seed-level feasible-action agreement point estimates must be >= 0.90 and non-N/A
high_snr_recovery.utility_rule: all ten S1 Ridge cost-on validation seed-level candidate-minus-independent-benchmark-hold utility deltas must be strictly > 0, and the aggregate must also pass Holm-adjusted one-sided p from conservative raw_p <= 0.05 with favorable point delta; cost-off is a paired diagnostic
high_snr_recovery.utility_per_seed_rule: for every seed in common.seeds, validation utility delta > 0 on the fixed synthetic_validation support; any N/A or nonpositive seed fails promotion
high_snr_recovery.clairvoyant_rule: for every seed on the identical synthetic_validation scored mask, mean realized same-state clairvoyant net utility/value must be strictly greater than the S1 Ridge validation mean realized net utility/value; any N/A, mask mismatch, or non-strict comparison fails; this is an upper-bound sanity check, not a selection target

s3_injected_signal.scope: injected BTC versus same-row zero-injection parent control on s3_validation [104528,139568), with one deterministic validation fit and independent benchmark hold paths
s3_injected_signal.utility_rule: Holm-adjusted one-sided p from conservative raw_p <= 0.05 and favorable point delta > 0 for the injected-control timing net-utility difference-in-differences using independent benchmark_hold_path in both arms
s3_injected_signal.forecast_rule: Holm-adjusted one-sided p from conservative raw_p <= 0.05 and favorable point delta > 0 for h4 MSE-skill difference-in-differences
s3_injected_signal.prefix_invariance_rule: future perturbation after origin cannot alter any earlier OOF prediction, mask, or fitted-prefix digest

trial_registry.hash_method: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 JSONL bytes
trial_registry.primary_record_rule: every record has primary=true; no result may add, remove, reorder, or relabel a record

primary_comparison_registry.hash_method: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 JSONL bytes
primary_comparison_registry.family_size_rule: count of JSONL records with primary=true; this count is the sole Holm-Bonferroni family size

runner_contract.outer_test_rows: report-only; never tune, select, or revise thresholds
runner_contract.v4_runtime_authentication_required: load_fixed_manifest must run first and its canonical/pinned digest, critical fields, and results_observed=false must be authoritative; only then may the body validator run
runner_contract.cost_contract_consistency: optimizer, teacher, student replay, U0, Q, and Backtest must all verify the mode-specific contract hash before scoring; a missing or mismatched hash fails closed
runner_contract.inventory_consistency: agreement and regret use each forecast policy's own carried p_{t-1}; U0/global hindsight inventory cannot enter row scoring or update policy state
runner_contract.generic_train_app_policy: unidream.experiments.train_app.run_training_app is the legacy generic WM->BC->AC application and is not a P1 research runner; a P1 runner is blocked unless it enters through v4_runtime_validation_entrypoint and uses the authenticated wrapper
runner_contract.action_primitive_start_condition: canonical authenticated action primitive producer and P1-specific moving-block bootstrap are implemented and validated; runner may start formal validation scoring under this manifest; the existing generic MBB is forbidden

synthetic_contract.output_slice: raw rows [512,120512) become output rows [0,120000); discard the first burn_in_rows from features and returns
synthetic_contract.state_formula: draw z0 as one scalar; draw xi with shape (120511,), then z_raw[0]=z0 and z_raw[k]=ar_rho*z_raw[k-1]+sqrt(1-ar_rho^2)*xi[k-1] for k=1..120511
synthetic_contract.observed_features_formula: x_raw[k,0] = z_raw[k]; x_raw[k,j] = noise_features[k,j-1] for j=1..16, with noise_features drawn before epsilon and all features generated before target; output x[t] = x_raw[t+512]
synthetic_contract.return_formula: r_raw[0] = return_noise_std*epsilon[0] (beta-independent sentinel); r_raw[k+1] = beta*z_raw[k] + return_noise_std*epsilon[k+1] for k=0..120510
synthetic_contract.target_formula: y[t,h] = sum(r[t+1:t+h+1]) for h in common.forecast_horizons after raw burn-in slicing
synthetic_contract.random_distribution: z0, every xi entry, every noise_features entry, and every epsilon entry are mutually independent iid standard normal N(0,1) draws
synthetic_contract.random_independence: z0, xi, noise_features, and epsilon are mutually independent; entries within each vector or matrix are iid
synthetic_contract.base_array_reuse: z_raw, noise_features, epsilon, and availability starts are identical for every beta; only the beta term in r_raw[k+1] changes
synthetic_contract.scenario_seed_policy: draw z, all 16 noise features, return-noise epsilon, and availability starts once per seed; reuse those arrays for S0, S1, S2-high, S2-medium, and S2-low, changing only beta
synthetic_contract.future_perturbation_test: add a fixed delta to returns strictly after an origin's target_end and assert all earlier predictions/masks are unchanged

availability.start_coordinate_system: starts are output-coordinate indices after the raw burn-in slice; valid start values are [512,119998) and are not raw pre-slice indices
availability.start_range: without-replacement starts in output-index range [512,119998) after raw burn-in slicing; the integer population passed to choice is 119998-512
availability.start_order_policy: retain the returned choice order in the artifact exactly; never sort the starts
availability.interval_union_policy: for each source, false_mask is the union of half-open output intervals [start,start+2); starts are unique but adjacent starts may overlap bars and the union is applied
availability.false_range: output indices [start, start + gap_block_length_bars); preserve those output rows and set only the sidecar flag false

outer_report_operation.range_semantics: fit_prefix_range and prediction_range are zero-based [start,end) right-exclusive; origin 100000 is excluded from the fit prefix
outer_report_operation.fit_rule: after every threshold and manifest field is fixed, fit exactly once at origin 100000 on the admissible prefix [0,100000) with target_end <= origin - purge_bars and label row < origin

mask_only_sanity.method: availability/context/target mask counting only with all three sources in context and spot-only target labels; no model fit or outcome inspection
mask_only_sanity.reported_value_role: conservative fixed reference from the preregistration mask-only derivation

S0.name: zero_signal
S0.hypothesis: fixed models and the action mapper do not manufacture a timing edge from noise
S0.randomness_role: uses the shared synthetic base stream; beta=0 is the only scenario mutation

S1.name: known_high_snr_dgp
S1.hypothesis: a known causal observable state is recovered under the complete timing and action contract
S1.randomness_role: uses the shared synthetic base stream; beta is the only return-process mutation

S2.name: monotonic_snr
S2.hypothesis: forecast skill, action agreement, and utility degrade monotonically as only SNR decreases
S2.randomness_role: one shared base stream per seed for all three levels; beta is the only mutation

S3.name: semi_synthetic_btc_observable_injection
S3.hypothesis: a known signal injected through an existing causal BTC feature is recovered under real v4 gaps, volatility, and costs

signal.observable_at: decision timestamp t after the close of bar t
signal.prefix_scaling_formula: z[t] = (close_ret[t] - mean(close_ret[u] for context_eligible[u] and u<t)) / max(std(close_ret[u] for context_eligible[u] and u<t, ddof=0), 1e-12)
signal.prefix_eligibility: context_eligible[u] only; target_complete and any future target/return mask are never inspected for prefix scaling
signal.injection_formula: only when context_eligible[t], t+1 is inside the feature body, t+1 is contiguous with t, and spot_bar_observed[t+1] is true: returns_injected[t+1] = returns_v4[t+1] + 0.0005*z[t]
signal.apply_only_to: context-eligible decision origins with an in-body, contiguous, spot-observed t+1 bar; invalid/gapped rows remain false and are not repaired
signal.hidden_state_policy: no generated z or latent column may be passed to the model; z is recomputable from the original named v4 close_ret feature and prefix fit record

S3.v4_row_alignment: use feature-body rows in their original order; sidecar lookup is exact timestamp membership; any non-15m adjacency or false sidecar value invalidates the complete window without compaction
S3.common_row_definition: decision origins whose 64-bar context has finite canonical 17 features and all three v4 availability masks true, and whose target window has finite spot returns with contiguous 15m timestamps; funding/mark masks are not required on future label bars
S3.common_row_index_definition: sorted raw feature-body indices with a complete 64-bar all-three-mask context and complete h16 spot-return target, after exact timestamp join; future funding/mark gaps alone do not remove a label

primary_inferential_operation.range_semantics: fit_raw_range and prediction_raw_range are original zero-based [start,end) raw-body indices; validation origin 104528 is excluded from the fit prefix
primary_inferential_operation.fit_rule: one fixed fit at the validation boundary using only admissible pre-validation rows with target_end <= origin - purge_bars; no validation or outer target enters the fit

S3.excluded_common_schedule_origin_reason: the eighth synthetic-relative origin would fall inside the sealed 2023-01-01 outer-test range after timestamp alignment
S3.outer_report_range_semantics: outer_report_fit_raw_range and outer_report_prediction_raw_range are original zero-based [start,end) raw-body indices; outer origin 139568 is excluded from the fit prefix
S3.outer_report_fit_rule: single report-only fit at raw index 139568 using the admissible prefix before that index and one prediction pass over raw [139568,173111); outer rows cannot tune, select, or change any development decision
S3.raw_index_boundary_note: resolve the four OOF-development origins after timestamp join, truncate the final development span at validation raw index 104528, fit validation once at raw 104528, and reserve raw [139568,173111) for the single report-only outer pass; raw body thirds are forbidden
S3.split_resolution: resolve each timestamp range against the immutable v4 body/sidecar join, preserve original row indices, and apply the common-row mask; never substitute raw body thirds
S3.origin_resolution: after the timestamp join, record OOF-development origins [72492,82492,92492,102492], validation origin 104528, and outer report origin 139568 with their resolved timestamps before fitting
S3.seed_policy: one deterministic S3 run; uncertainty comes from the fixed paired moving-block bootstrap rather than pseudo-replicate seeds
